name: Honda PCX
engine: 125, 150 or 160 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT
intro: Honda's best-selling small scooter. Some accessory top box mounts were recalled.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. If the scooter has a Honda accessory rear trunk, check the base against recall 16E023. Those trunk bases can let the box fall off.
A-002.reason: A top box falling off in traffic is a hazard to you and others. The fix is free.

recalls.years: Accessory trunk bases sold for 2013-2016 PCX150 (also fitted to PCX125)
recalls.what: Accessory rear trunk base may let the trunk come off.
recalls.fix: Honda replaces the trunk base free.
